svg.title: B2 versus B1 · cumulative QLIKE differences
svg.desc: Four panels with independent scales; two families, two horizons and two windows.
svg.text: B2 versus B1 · cumulative QLIKE differences
Σ session [QLIKE(B1) − QLIKE(B2)]. Positive favours B2; negative favours B1.
Each panel has its own Y axis: compare values, not heights across panels. Complete curves; no days removed.
Calendar context — markers neither establish causality nor change the calculation:
A · 2025-04-07 and 2025-04-09: tariff week (context, not causality).
B · 2025-05-15: provider outage. C · 2025-09-17: FOMC. D · 2025-09-18: provider outage.
E · 2026-06-17: FOMC. F · 2026-08-31: AMZN, observed shock; news or earnings attribution NOT established.
Sources: frozen session losses and summaries. RV15 is the primary horizon for v4; RV5 is secondary.
